question: persister

ideas.title: Barcoded lineage tracing with live fate tracking ("fickle, freckled")
ideas.description: Label genetically identical cells with unique heritable DNA barcodes, then apply a drug pulse and track each lineage by time-lapse imaging and barcode sequencing. This separates cells that were already tolerant from cells that switched into a tolerant state after treatment, and shows whether survival is a stable inherited trait or a reversible, stochastic 'freckle' that changes over time.

ideas.title: Pre-treatment single-cell multi-omics to find predictive "dappled" states
ideas.description: Profile untreated cells with paired scRNA-seq and scATAC-seq (or CITE-seq), then sort or computationally match cells by their eventual fate after treatment. Training a classifier on pre-treatment transcriptional and chromatin states identifies the rare pre-existing programs (for example, a slow-cycling or stress-response state) that predict survival before any drug is given.

ideas.title: Live single-cell kinetic reporters of drug-target signaling ("swift, slow")
ideas.description: Express FRET biosensors for the drug target's downstream pathway (e.g., ERK or AKT activity) and a cell-cycle reporter, then record signaling dynamics in each cell during drug exposure. Comparing the timing, amplitude, and recovery of pathway suppression between survivors and dying cells tests whether rapid rebound or a slow, incomplete pathway shutdown explains persistence.

ideas.title: Spatial mapping of survivor niches before and after treatment ("landscape plotted and pieced")
ideas.description: Use multiplexed spatial imaging (e.g., MERFISH, CODEX, or imaging mass cytometry) on tumor sections or organoids collected before treatment, during treatment, and at relapse. Analyzing the local neighborhood, oxygenation, extracellular matrix, and proximity to stromal or immune cells reveals whether survivors occupy a distinct microenvironment that protects them.

ideas.title: Genome-wide CRISPR screen with reversibility and re-challenge tests ("counter, original, spare, strange")
ideas.description: Run a pooled CRISPR knockout screen under sustained drug treatment, comparing guide enrichment in survivors versus the starting population, then validate hits in sorted survivors that are released from drug and re-challenged. Measuring whether tolerance is reversible and whether knockouts shift the survival fraction distinguishes genetic resistance from transient, epigenetically maintained persistence.
